title: Battle of Dervenakia
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Dervenakia", at revision 1381235047, opens: "The Battle of Dervenakia was the Greek victory over the Ottoman forces on 6–8 August 1822, an important event in the Greek War of Independence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q82698, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1822 battle in the Greek War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
